card.name: The word under in drug text
card.fires_on: The word "under" (or "Under"), including the start of "undergo", in drug-label text. It appears after a drug or verb, as in "under close medical supervision", "under fasting conditions" or "drugs that undergo".

modes.label: Undergo
modes.description: "Under" is the first piece of "undergo", as in drugs that undergo renal tubular secretion.
modes.example: Drugs that<< Under>>go Renal Tubular Secretion Clinical

modes.label: Under conditions
modes.description: "Under" introduces a condition or setting, such as close medical supervision or fasting conditions.
modes.example: Initiate treatment with amlodipine and olmesartan medoxomil tablets<< under>> close medical supervision.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for the next piece of a word or phrase, such as "go", but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It marks the word "under", as in "undergo" or "under close supervision".
